verses.en: There are, in the church, two priesthoods, namely, the Melchizedek and Aaronic, including the Levitical Priesthood.
verses.sm: Ua i ai i le ekalesia ni perisitua e lua, ua igoa, o le Mekisateko ma le Arona, e aofia ai le Perisitua faa-Levi.

verses.en: Why the first is called the Melchizedek Priesthood is because Melchizedek was such a great high priest.
verses.sm: O le pogai ua ta’ua ai le muamua o le Perisitua Mekisateko ona o Mekisateko sa avea o se faitaulaga sili lona iloga.

verses.en: Before his day it was called the Holy Priesthood, after the Order of the Son of God.
verses.sm: Ao lei oo mai i ona aso sa ta’ua o le Perisitua Paia, e tusa ma le Faatulagaga a le Alo o le Atua.

verses.en: But out of respect or reverence to the name of the Supreme Being, to avoid the too frequent repetition of his name, they, the church, in ancient days, called that priesthood after Melchizedek, or the Melchizedek Priesthood.
verses.sm: Ae ona o le faaaloalo po o le ava i le suafa o Lē Silisili, e aloese ai mai le ta’ua soo o lona suafa, o lea na faaigoa ai e i latou, o le ekalesia, i aso anamua, lena perisitua ia Mekisateko, po o le Perisitua Mekisateko.

verses.en: All other authorities or offices in the church are appendages to this priesthood.
verses.sm: O isi pule uma po o tofi i le ekalesia o ni faaopoopoga i lenei perisitua.

verses.en: But there are two divisions or grand heads—one is the Melchizedek Priesthood, and the other is the Aaronic or Levitical Priesthood.
verses.sm: Ae ua i ai ni vaega se lua po o ni ao tetele— o le tasi o le Perisitua Mekisateko, ma le isi o le Perisitua Arona po o le Perisitua faa-Levi.

verses.en: The office of an elder comes under the priesthood of Melchizedek.
verses.sm: O le tofi o se toeaina e i lalo o le perisitua o Mekisateko.

verses.en: The Melchizedek Priesthood holds the right of presidency, and has power and authority over all the offices in the church in all ages of the world, to administer in spiritual things.
verses.sm: O le Perisitua Mekisateko e umia le aiā o le pulefaamalumalu, ma ua i ai le mana ma le pule i luga o tofi uma i le ekalesia i tupulaga uma o le lalolagi, e taitai ai i mea faaleagaga.

verses.en: The Presidency of the High Priesthood, after the order of Melchizedek, have a right to officiate in all the offices in the church.
verses.sm: O le Au Peresitene o le Perisitua Maualuga, e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko, ua i ai le aiā e galue ai i tofi uma i le ekalesia.

verses.en: High priests after the order of the Melchizedek Priesthood have a right to officiate in their own standing, under the direction of the presidency, in administering spiritual things, and also in the office of an elder, priest (of the Levitical order), teacher, deacon, and member.
verses.sm: O faitaulaga sili e tusa ma le faatulagaga o le Perisitua Mekisateko ua i ai se aiā e galulue ai i o latou lava tulaga, i lalo o le taitaiga a le au peresitene, i le taulimaina o mea faaleagaga, ma i le tofi foi o se toeaina, ositaulaga (o le faatulagaga faa-Levi), aoao, tiakono, ma tagata o le ekalesia.

verses.en: An elder has a right to officiate in his stead when the high priest is not present.
verses.sm: O se toeaina ua i ai le aiā e galue ai i lona tulaga pe a lē o i ai le faitaulaga sili.

verses.en: The high priest and elder are to administer in spiritual things, agreeable to the covenants and commandments of the church; and they have a right to officiate in all these offices of the church when there are no higher authorities present.
verses.sm: O le faitaulaga sili ma le toeaina ia taitai i mea faaleagaga, e tusa ma feagaiga ma poloaiga o le ekalesia; ma ua i ai ia i laua se aiā e galulue ai i ia tofi uma o le ekalesia pe a lē o i ai ni isi pule maualuluga atu.

verses.en: The second priesthood is called the Priesthood of Aaron, because it was conferred upon Aaron and his seed, throughout all their generations.
verses.sm: O le perisitua lona lua ua ta’ua o le Perisitua o Arona, ona sa faaee lenei perisitua i luga o Arona ma lana fanau, i o latou tupulaga uma.

verses.en: Why it is called the lesser priesthood is because it is an appendage to the greater, or the Melchizedek Priesthood, and has power in administering outward ordinances.
verses.sm: O le pogai ua ta’ua ai lenei perisitua o le perisitua maualalo ona o lenei perisitua o se faaopoopoga i le perisitua maualuga, po o le Perisitua Mekisateko, ma ua i ai le mana e taulimaina ai sauniga faaletino.

verses.en: The bishopric is the presidency of this priesthood, and holds the keys or authority of the same.
verses.sm: O le au epikopo o le au peresitene o lenei perisitua, ma e umia ki po o le pule o lea lava perisitua.

verses.en: No man has a legal right to this office, to hold the keys of this priesthood, except he be a literal descendant of Aaron.
verses.sm: E leai se alii ua i ai se aiā faaletulafono i lenei tofi, e umia ai ki o lenei perisitua, vagana ai o ia o se e tupuga moni mai ia Arona.

verses.en: But as a high priest of the Melchizedek Priesthood has authority to officiate in all the lesser offices, he may officiate in the office of bishop when no literal descendant of Aaron can be found, provided he is called and set apart and ordained unto this power by the hands of the Presidency of the Melchizedek Priesthood.
verses.sm: Ae ona ua i ai i se faitaulaga sili o le Perisitua Mekisateko le pule e galue ai i tofi maualalo uma, e mafai ona galue o ia i le tofi o le epikopo pe a lē mafai ona maua se e tupuga moni mai ia Arona, pe a faapea e valaaulia ma vaetofia ma faauu o ia i lenei mana e ala i aao o le Au Peresitene o le Perisitua Mekisateko.

verses.en: The power and authority of the higher, or Melchizedek Priesthood, is to hold the keys of all the spiritual blessings of the church—
verses.sm: O le mana ma le pule o le perisitua maualuga, po o le Perisitua Mekisateko, o le umia lea o ki o faamanuiaga uma faaleagaga o le ekalesia—

verses.en: To have the privilege of receiving the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, to have the heavens opened unto them, to commune with the general assembly and church of the Firstborn, and to enjoy the communion and presence of God the Father, and Jesus the mediator of the new covenant.
verses.sm: O le mauaina o le avanoa e maua ai mealilo o le malo o le lagi, e tatala mai ai le lagi ia te i latou, e mafuta ai ma le faapotopotoga aoao ma le ekalesia a le Ulumatua, ma olioli i le mafutaga ma le afio ai o le Atua le Tamā, ma Iesu le puluvaga o le feagaiga fou.

verses.en: The power and authority of the lesser, or Aaronic Priesthood, is to hold the keys of the ministering of angels, and to administer in outward ordinances, the letter of the gospel, the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins, agreeable to the covenants and commandments.
verses.sm: O le mana ma le pule o le perisitua maualalo, po o le Perisitua Arona, o le umia lea o ki o le auaunaga a agelu, ma fai sauniga faaletino, le sauniga lea o le talalelei, o le papatisoga o le salamo mo le faamagaloina o agasala, e tusa ai ma feagaiga ma poloaiga.

verses.en: Of necessity there are presidents, or presiding officers growing out of, or appointed of or from among those who are ordained to the several offices in these two priesthoods.
verses.sm: Ona e tatau ai, e i ai peresitene, po o mautofi pulefaamalumalu, e afua mai pe tofia mai i totonu o i latou o e ua faauuina i tofi eseese i nei perisitua e lua.

verses.en: Of the Melchizedek Priesthood, three Presiding High Priests, chosen by the body, appointed and ordained to that office, and upheld by the confidence, faith, and prayer of the church, form a quorum of the Presidency of the Church.
verses.sm: Mai i le Perisitua Mekisateko, e toatolu Faitaulaga Sili Pulefaamalumalu, e filifili e le tino potopoto, e tofia ma faauu i lena tofi, ma e lagolagoina e le talitonuga, faatuatua, ma tatalo a le ekalesia, e faia ai se korama o le Au Peresitene o le Ekalesia.

verses.en: The twelve traveling councilors are called to be the Twelve Apostles, or special witnesses of the name of Christ in all the world—thus differing from other officers in the church in the duties of their calling.
verses.sm: O fautua femalagaai e toasefululua ua valaaulia e avea ma Aposetolo e Toasefululua, po o molimau faapitoa o le suafa o Keriso i le lalolagi atoa— ua faapea ona ese ai mai i isi mautofi i le ekalesia i tiute o lo latou valaauga.

verses.en: And they form a quorum, equal in authority and power to the three presidents previously mentioned.
verses.sm: Ma ua avea i latou o se korama, e tutusa i le pule ma le mana ma peresitene e toatolu na ta’ua muamua.

verses.en: The Seventy are also called to preach the gospel, and to be especial witnesses unto the Gentiles and in all the world—thus differing from other officers in the church in the duties of their calling.
verses.sm: O le Toafitugafulu ua valaaulia foi e talai atu le talalelei, ma avea ma molimau faapitoa i Nuuese ma i le lalolagi atoa— ua faapea ona ese ai mai isi mautofi i le ekalesia i tiute o lo latou valaauga.

verses.en: And they form a quorum, equal in authority to that of the Twelve special witnesses or Apostles just named.
verses.sm: Ma ua avea i latou o se korama, e tutusa i le pule ma lena molimau faapitoa e Toasefululua po o Aposetolo na faatoa mavae atu nei lava ona ta’ua.

verses.en: And every decision made by either of these quorums must be by the unanimous voice of the same; that is, every member in each quorum must be agreed to its decisions, in order to make their decisions of the same power or validity one with the other—
verses.sm: Ma o faaiuga uma e faia e soo se tasi o nei korama e ao lava ina faia i le leo autasi o ia lava korama; o lona uiga, e ao i uso taitoatasi o korama taitasi ona ioe i faaiuga a le korama, ina ia faia a latou faaiuga i le mana po o le pule lava lea o le tasi ma le isi—

verses.en: A majority may form a quorum when circumstances render it impossible to be otherwise—
verses.sm: E mafai ona avea le vaega toatele ma korama pe a i ai ni tulaga e lē mafai ai ona faia ai—

verses.en: Unless this is the case, their decisions are not entitled to the same blessings which the decisions of a quorum of three presidents were anciently, who were ordained after the order of Melchizedek, and were righteous and holy men.
verses.sm: Vagana ai o le tulaga lea, e lē aiā a latou faaiuga i faamanuiaga tutusa sa i ai i faaiuga a se korama a peresitene e toatolu anamua, o e na faauuina e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko, ma o ni alii amiotonu ma paia.

verses.en: The decisions of these quorums, or either of them, are to be made in all righteousness, in holiness, and lowliness of heart, meekness and long-suffering, and in faith, and virtue, and knowledge, temperance, patience, godliness, brotherly kindness and charity;
verses.sm: O faaiuga a ia korama, po o se tasi o ia korama, ia faia i le amiotonu atoa, i le paia, ma le maualalo o le loto, agamalu ma le tali-tiga, ma i le faatuatua, ma le amiomama, ma le poto, faautauta, onosai, amioatua, agalelei faaleuso ma le alofa mama;

verses.en: Because the promise is, if these things abound in them they shall not be unfruitful in the knowledge of the Lord.
verses.sm: Auā o le folafolaga e faapea, afai e faateleina ia mea ia te i latou o le a lē aunoa i latou ona fua tele mai i le malamalama o le Alii.

verses.en: And in case that any decision of these quorums is made in unrighteousness, it may be brought before a general assembly of the several quorums, which constitute the spiritual authorities of the church; otherwise there can be no appeal from their decision.
verses.sm: Ma i le tulaga e faia ai se faaiuga a nei korama i le amioletonu, e mafai ona aumai lena faaiuga i luma o se faapotopotoga aoao a korama eseese, lea ua faia ma pule faaleagaga o le ekalesia; a lē o lea e leai se apili e mafai ona faia mai la latou faaiuga.

verses.en: The Twelve are a Traveling Presiding High Council, to officiate in the name of the Lord, under the direction of the Presidency of the Church, agreeable to the institution of heaven; to build up the church, and regulate all the affairs of the same in all nations, first unto the Gentiles and secondly unto the Jews.
verses.sm: O le Toasefululua o se Aufono Maualuga Femalagaai Pulefaamalumalu, e galulue i le suafa o le Alii, i lalo o le taitaiga a le Au Peresitene o le Ekalesia, e tusa ai ma le faatulagaga a le lagi; e ati a’e le ekalesia, ma pulea mataupu uma o lea lava ekalesia i atunuu uma, muamua i Nuuese ma lona lua i tagata Iutaia.

verses.en: The Seventy are to act in the name of the Lord, under the direction of the Twelve or the traveling high council, in building up the church and regulating all the affairs of the same in all nations, first unto the Gentiles and then to the Jews—
verses.sm: O le Toafitugafulu e galulue i le suafa o le Alii, i lalo o le taitaiga a le Toasefululua po o le aufono maualuga femalagaai, i le atiina a’e o le ekalesia ma le pulea o mataupu uma o lea lava ekalesia i atunuu uma, muamua i Nuuese ona oo atu ai lea i tagata Iutaia—

verses.en: The Twelve being sent out, holding the keys, to open the door by the proclamation of the gospel of Jesus Christ, and first unto the Gentiles and then unto the Jews.
verses.sm: Aua ua auina atu le Toasefululua, ua umia ki, e tatala le faitotoa e ala i le folafola atu o le talalelei a Iesu Keriso, ma e muamua i Nuuese ma ona oo atu ai lea i tagata Iutaia.

verses.en: The standing high councils, at the stakes of Zion, form a quorum equal in authority in the affairs of the church, in all their decisions, to the quorum of the presidency, or to the traveling high council.
verses.sm: O ’aufono maualuga tumau, i siteki o Siona, ua avea o se korama e tutusa i le pule i mataupu o le ekalesia, ma le korama a le au peresitene, pe ma le aufono maualuga femalagaai, i a latou faaiuga uma.

verses.en: The high council in Zion form a quorum equal in authority in the affairs of the church, in all their decisions, to the councils of the Twelve at the stakes of Zion.
verses.sm: O le aufono maualuga i Siona ua avea o se korama e tutusa i le pule i mataupu o le ekalesia, i a latou faaiuga uma, ma aufono a le Toasefululua i siteki o Siona.

verses.en: It is the duty of the traveling high council to call upon the Seventy, when they need assistance, to fill the several calls for preaching and administering the gospel, instead of any others.
verses.sm: O le tiute o le aufono maualuga femalagaai o le valaau atu i le Toafitugafulu, pe a latou manaomia se fesoasoani, e faatutumu valaauga eseese mo le talaiga ma le taulimaina o le talalelei, nai lo soo se isi lava.

verses.en: It is the duty of the Twelve, in all large branches of the church, to ordain evangelical ministers, as they shall be designated unto them by revelation—
verses.sm: O le tiute o le Toasefululua, i paranesi tetele uma o le ekalesia, le faauu o faifeau faaevagelia, e pei ona o le a faasino mai ia te i latou i faaaliga—

verses.en: The order of this priesthood was confirmed to be handed down from father to son, and rightly belongs to the literal descendants of the chosen seed, to whom the promises were made.
verses.sm: O le faatulagaga o lenei perisitua sa faamauina e tuulima faasolo mai i lalo mai le tamā i le atalii, ma ua tatau tonu i fanau moni o le fanau filifilia, o e na faia i ai folafolaga.

verses.en: This order was instituted in the days of Adam, and came down by lineage in the following manner:
verses.sm: O lenei faatulagaga sa faatuina i aso o Atamu, ma sa faasolo mai i lalo e ala mai i le gafa i le ala lenei:

verses.en: From Adam to Seth, who was ordained by Adam at the age of sixty-nine years, and was blessed by him three years previous to his (Adam’s) death, and received the promise of God by his father, that his posterity should be the chosen of the Lord, and that they should be preserved unto the end of the earth;
verses.sm: Mai ia Atamu ia Setu, o lē na faauu e Atamu i le ono-sefulu-iva o tausaga, ma sa faamanuia e ia i le tolu tausaga i luma mai o lona (Atamu) maliu, ma maua le folafolaga a le Atua e ala mai i lona tamā, e faapea o le a avea ana fanau ma e filifilia o le Alii, ma o le a faasaoina i latou e oo i le iuga o le lalolagi;

verses.en: Because he (Seth) was a perfect man, and his likeness was the express likeness of his father, insomuch that he seemed to be like unto his father in all things, and could be distinguished from him only by his age.
verses.sm: Aua o ia (Setu) o se tagata sa atoatoa, ma o ona foliga o foliga tonu lava o lona tamā, sa tele ina foliga mai ai o ia e pei o lona tamā i mea uma, ma nao ona tausaga na mafai ona iloa ese ai o ia mai ia te ia.

verses.en: Enos was ordained at the age of one hundred and thirty-four years and four months, by the hand of Adam.
verses.sm: Sa faauu Enosa i le selau tolu-sefulu ma le fa tausaga ma le fa masina, e le lima o Atamu.

verses.en: God called upon Cainan in the wilderness in the fortieth year of his age; and he met Adam in journeying to the place Shedolamak. He was eighty-seven years old when he received his ordination.
verses.sm: Sa oo ifo le Atua ia Kainano i le vao i le fasefulu o ona tausaga; ma sa fetaia’i o ia ma Atamu i le malaga atu i le nofoaga o Shedolamak. O ia na valusefulu-fitu tausaga o le matua i le taimi na maua ai e ia lona faauuga.

verses.en: Mahalaleel was four hundred and ninety-six years and seven days old when he was ordained by the hand of Adam, who also blessed him.
verses.sm: O Maalaelu na fa selau ivasefulu-ono tausaga ma le fitu aso le matua i le taimi na faauu ai o ia e le lima o Atamu, o lē na faamanuiaina foi o ia.

verses.en: Jared was two hundred years old when he was ordained under the hand of Adam, who also blessed him.
verses.sm: O Iareto na lua selau tausaga le matua i le taimi na faauu ai o ia i lalo o le lima o Atamu, o lē na faamanuiaina foi o ia.

verses.en: Enoch was twenty-five years old when he was ordained under the hand of Adam; and he was sixty-five and Adam blessed him.
verses.sm: O Enoka na luasefulu-lima tausaga le matua i le taimi na faauu ai o ia i lalo o le lima o Atamu; ma na onosefulu-lima o ia ae faamanuia o ia e Atamu.

verses.en: And he saw the Lord, and he walked with him, and was before his face continually; and he walked with God three hundred and sixty-five years, making him four hundred and thirty years old when he was translated.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai o ia i le Alii, ma sa savali o ia faatasi ma ia, ma sa i ai i luma o ona fofoga e lē aunoa; ma sa savali o ia faatasi ma le Atua i le tolu selau ma le onosefulu-lima tausaga, na maua ai e ia le fa selau tolusefulu tausaga le matua i le taimi na liua ai o ia.

verses.en: Methuselah was one hundred years old when he was ordained under the hand of Adam.
verses.sm: O Metusela na selau tausaga le matua i le taimi na faauu ai o ia i lalo o le lima o Atamu.

verses.en: Lamech was thirty-two years old when he was ordained under the hand of Seth.
verses.sm: O Lameko na tolusefulu-lua tausaga le matua i le taimi na faauu ai o ia i lalo o le lima o Setu.

verses.en: Noah was ten years old when he was ordained under the hand of Methuselah.
verses.sm: O Noa na sefulu tausaga le matua i le taimi na faauu ai o ia i lalo o le lima o Metusela.

verses.en: Three years previous to the death of Adam, he called Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jared, Enoch, and Methuselah, who were all high priests, with the residue of his posterity who were righteous, into the valley of Adam-ondi-Ahman, and there bestowed upon them his last blessing.
verses.sm: E tolu tausaga ae lei maliu Atamu, na valaaulia ai e ia Setu, Enosa, Kainano, Maalaelu, Iareto, Enoka, ma Metusela, o e sa faitaulaga sili uma, faatasi ma e na totoe o ana fanau o e na amiotonu, i le vanu o Atamu-onai-Amani, ma o iina na faaee atu ai e ia ia te i latou lana faamanuiaga mulimuli.

verses.en: And the Lord appeared unto them, and they rose up and blessed Adam, and called him Michael, the prince, the archangel.
verses.sm: Ma sa afio mai le Alii ia te i latou, ma sa latou tutulai i luga ma faamanuia atu ia Atamu, ma ta’ua o ia o Mekaeli, le aloalii, le agelu sili.

verses.en: And the Lord administered comfort unto Adam, and said unto him: I have set thee to be at the head; a multitude of nations shall come of thee, and thou art a prince over them forever.
verses.sm: Ma sa tuu mai e le Alii le faamafanafanaga ia Atamu, ma fetalai mai ia te ia: Ua Ou faatuina oe ia avea ma ulu; o le a tutupu mai ia te oe atunuu e tele, ma o le a avea oe o se aloalii i luga o i latou e faavavau.

verses.en: And Adam stood up in the midst of the congregation; and, notwithstanding he was bowed down with age, being full of the Holy Ghost, predicted whatsoever should befall his posterity unto the latest generation.
verses.sm: Ma sa tulai i luga Atamu i le lotolotoi o le faapotopotoga; ma, e ui ina sa faano’uno’u o ia i le matua, ua tumu o ia i le Agaga Paia, ma valoia soo se mea o le a oo mai i ana fanau e oo lava i le tupulaga mulimuli.

verses.en: These things were all written in the book of Enoch, and are to be testified of in due time.
verses.sm: O nei mea uma sa tusia i le tusi a Enoka, ma o le a molimauina i le taimi tatau ai.

verses.en: It is the duty of the Twelve, also, to ordain and set in order all the other officers of the church, agreeable to the revelation which says:
verses.sm: O le tiute foi o le Toasefululua, le faauuina ma faatulagaina tatau o isi mautofi uma o le ekalesia, e tusa ma le faaaliga ua fai mai:

verses.en: To the church of Christ in the land of Zion, in addition to the church laws respecting church business—
verses.sm: I le ekalesia a Keriso o i le laueleele o Siona, e faaopoopo i tulafono a le ekalesia e faatatau i mataupu a le ekalesia—

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you, saith the Lord of Hosts, there must needs be presiding elders to preside over those who are of the office of an elder;
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii o ’Au, e tatau ona i ai ni toeaina pulefaamalumalu e pulefaamalumalu i luga o i latou o e o le tofi o le toeaina;

verses.en: And also priests to preside over those who are of the office of a priest;
verses.sm: Ma ni ositaulaga foi e pulefaamalumalu i luga o i latou o e o le tofi o le ositaulaga;

verses.en: And also teachers to preside over those who are of the office of a teacher, in like manner, and also the deacons—
verses.sm: Ma ni aoao foi e pulefaamalumalu i luga o i latou o e o le tofi o le aoao, i le ala lava faapea, ma tiakono foi—

verses.en: Wherefore, from deacon to teacher, and from teacher to priest, and from priest to elder, severally as they are appointed, according to the covenants and commandments of the church.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, mai le tiakono i le aoao, ma mai le aoao i le ositaulaga, ma mai ositaulaga i le toeaina, e pei ona tofia ai i latou taitoatasi, e tusa ma feagaiga ma poloaiga o le ekalesia.

verses.en: Then comes the High Priesthood, which is the greatest of all.
verses.sm: Ona oo mai ai lea o le Perisitua Maualuga, le silisili lea o perisitua uma.

verses.en: Wherefore, it must needs be that one be appointed of the High Priesthood to preside over the priesthood, and he shall be called President of the High Priesthood of the Church;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e tatau ona i ai se tasi o le Perisitua Maualuga e tofia e pulefaamalumalu i luga o le perisitua, ma ia ta’ua o ia o le Peresitene o le Perisitua Maualuga o le Ekalesia;

verses.en: Or, in other words, the Presiding High Priest over the High Priesthood of the Church.
verses.sm: Pe faapea foi, o le Faitaulaga Sili Pulefaamalumalu i luga o le Perisitua Maualuga o le Ekalesia.

verses.en: From the same comes the administering of ordinances and blessings upon the church, by the laying on of the hands.
verses.sm: E mai lea lava e sau ai le faia o sauniga ma faamanuiaga i luga o le ekalesia, e ala i le faaee atu o lima.

verses.en: Wherefore, the office of a bishop is not equal unto it; for the office of a bishop is in administering all temporal things;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le tofi o le epikopo e lē tutusa ma lea; ona o le tofi o le epikopo e i ai lea i le faatautaiga o mea uma faaletino;

verses.en: Nevertheless a bishop must be chosen from the High Priesthood, unless he is a literal descendant of Aaron;
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea o se epikopo e ao ina filifilia mai le Perisitua Maualuga, vagana ai o ia o se e tupuga moni mai ia Arona;

verses.en: For unless he is a literal descendant of Aaron he cannot hold the keys of that priesthood.
verses.sm: Aua vagana ai o ia o se e tupuga moni mai ia Arona e lē mafai ona umia e ia ki o lena perisitua.

verses.en: Nevertheless, a high priest, that is, after the order of Melchizedek, may be set apart unto the ministering of temporal things, having a knowledge of them by the Spirit of truth;
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, o se faitaulaga sili, o lona uiga, e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko, e mafai ona vaetofia i le faatautaiga o mea faaletino, ma maua se malamalama e uiga i ia mea e ala i le Agaga o le upumoni;

verses.en: And also to be a judge in Israel, to do the business of the church, to sit in judgment upon transgressors upon testimony as it shall be laid before him according to the laws, by the assistance of his counselors, whom he has chosen or will choose among the elders of the church.
verses.sm: Ma avea foi o se faamasino i Isaraelu, e fai tiute o le ekalesia, e nofo e faamasino i luga o e solitulafono e tusa ma molimau e pei ona o le a tuu mai i ona luma e tusa ma tulafono, e ala i le fesoasoani a ona fesoasoani, o e ua filifili e ia pe o le a filifili e ia mai totonu o toeaina o le ekalesia.

verses.en: This is the duty of a bishop who is not a literal descendant of Aaron, but has been ordained to the High Priesthood after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.sm: O le tiute lea o se epikopo e lē o se e tupuga moni mai ia Arona, ae ua faauu i le Perisitua Maualuga e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko.

verses.en: Thus shall he be a judge, even a common judge among the inhabitants of Zion, or in a stake of Zion, or in any branch of the church where he shall be set apart unto this ministry, until the borders of Zion are enlarged and it becomes necessary to have other bishops or judges in Zion or elsewhere.
verses.sm: O le a faapea ona avea o ia o se faamasino, o se faamasino lautele lava i totonu o e nonofo i Siona, po o i se siteki o Siona, po o i soo se paranesi o le ekalesia e vaetofia i ai o ia i lenei galuega, sei oo ina faalauteleina tuaoi o Siona ma tatau ai ona i ai o ni isi epikopo po o faamasino i Siona po o isi mea.

verses.en: And inasmuch as there are other bishops appointed they shall act in the same office.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma le tofiaina o isi epikopo latou te galulue i lea lava tofi.

verses.en: But a literal descendant of Aaron has a legal right to the presidency of this priesthood, to the keys of this ministry, to act in the office of bishop independently, without counselors, except in a case where a President of the High Priesthood, after the order of Melchizedek, is tried, to sit as a judge in Israel.
verses.sm: Ae o se e tupuga moni mai ia Arona ua i ai le aiā faaletulafono i le tulaga peresitene o lenei perisitua, i ki o lea auaunaga, e galue ai i le tofi o le epikopo nao ia, e aunoa ma ni fesoasoani, vagana ai i se tulaga e faamasino ai se Peresitene o le Perisitua Maualuga, e tusa ma le faatulagaga a Mekisateko, e nofo ai o se faamasino i Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the decision of either of these councils, agreeable to the commandment which says:
verses.sm: Ma o le faaiuga a soo se tasi o ia aufono, e tusa ai ma le poloaiga ua fai mai:

verses.en: Again, verily, I say unto you, the most important business of the church, and the most difficult cases of the church, inasmuch as there is not satisfaction upon the decision of the bishop or judges, it shall be handed over and carried up unto the council of the church, before the Presidency of the High Priesthood.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni, Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, o tiute sili ona taua o le ekalesia, ma faamasinoga sili ona faigata o le ekalesia, e tusa ai ma le lē maua o se maliega i le faaiuga a le epikopo po o faamasino, ia tuu atu ma tauaveina i luga i le aufono a le ekalesia, i luma o le Au Peresitene o le Perisitua Maualuga.

verses.en: And the Presidency of the council of the High Priesthood shall have power to call other high priests, even twelve, to assist as counselors; and thus the Presidency of the High Priesthood and its counselors shall have power to decide upon testimony according to the laws of the church.
verses.sm: Ma o le Au Peresitene o le aufono o le Perisitua Maualuga o le a i ai le mana e valaaulia ai isi faitaulaga sili, e toasefululua lava, e fesoasoani o ni fesoasoani; ma o le a faapea ona i ai i le Au Peresitene o le Perisitua Maualuga ma ona fesoasoani, le mana e filifili ai i molimau e tusa ma tulafono o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And after this decision it shall be had in remembrance no more before the Lord; for this is the highest council of the church of God, and a final decision upon controversies in spiritual matters.
verses.sm: Ma a uma lenei faaiuga o le a lē toe manatuaina lea mea i luma o le Alii; ona o le aufono aupito maualuga lenei o le ekalesia a le Atua, ma o se faaiuga faaiu lea i luga o feteena’iga i mataupu faaleagaga.

verses.en: There is not any person belonging to the church who is exempt from this council of the church.
verses.sm: E leai se tagata e auai i le ekalesia e tu’usaunoaina mai lenei aufono a le ekalesia.

verses.en: And inasmuch as a President of the High Priesthood shall transgress, he shall be had in remembrance before the common council of the church, who shall be assisted by twelve counselors of the High Priesthood;
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma le solitulafono o se Peresitene o le Perisitua Maualuga, ia manatua o ia i luma o le aufono lautele o le ekalesia, e fesoasoani i ai fautua e toasefululua o le Perisitua Maualuga;

verses.en: And their decision upon his head shall be an end of controversy concerning him.
verses.sm: Ma o la latou faaiuga i luga o lona ulu ia fai ma iuga o le feteena’iga e faatatau ia te ia.

verses.en: Thus, none shall be exempted from the justice and the laws of God, that all things may be done in order and in solemnity before him, according to truth and righteousness.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e leai se tasi e faaesea mai le faamasinotonu ma tulafono a le Atua, ina ia mafai ona faia o mea uma i le faatulagaga tatau ma le mamalu i ona luma, e tusa ma le upumoni ma le amiotonu.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, the duty of a president over the office of a deacon is to preside over twelve deacons, to sit in council with them, and to teach them their duty, edifying one another, as it is given according to the covenants.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le tiute o se peresitene e i luga o le tofi o le tiakono, o le pulefaamalumalu i luga o tiakono e toasefululua, o le fono faatasi ma i latou, ma aoao atu ia te i latou o latou tiute, e faagaeetia ai e le tasi le isi, e pei ona tuuina mai e tusa ma feagaiga.

verses.en: And also the duty of the president over the office of the teachers is to preside over twenty-four of the teachers, and to sit in council with them, teaching them the duties of their office, as given in the covenants.
verses.sm: O lenei foi o le tiute o le peresitene e i luga o le tofi o aoao o le pulefaamalumalu i luga o aoao e luasefulu-fa, ma fono faatasi ma i latou, ma aoao atu ia te i latou tiute o lo latou tofi, e pei ona tuuina mai i feagaiga.

verses.en: Also the duty of the president over the Priesthood of Aaron is to preside over forty-eight priests, and sit in council with them, to teach them the duties of their office, as is given in the covenants—
verses.sm: O lenei foi o le tiute o le peresitene e i luga o le Perisitua o Arona o le pulefaamalumalu i luga o ositaulaga e fasefulu-valu, ma fono faatasi ma i latou, e aoao atu ia te i latou tiute o lo latou tofi, e pei ona tuuina mai i feagaiga—

verses.en: This president is to be a bishop; for this is one of the duties of this priesthood.
verses.sm: O lenei peresitene o se epikopo; aua o se tasi lea o tiute o lenei perisitua.

verses.en: Again, the duty of the president over the office of elders is to preside over ninety-six elders, and to sit in council with them, and to teach them according to the covenants.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le tiute o le peresitene e i luga o le tofi o toeaina o le pulefaamalumalu i luga o toeaina e ivasefulu-ono, ma fono faatasi ma i latou, ma aoao i latou e tusa ma feagaiga.

verses.en: This presidency is a distinct one from that of the seventy, and is designed for those who do not travel into all the world.
verses.sm: O lenei au peresitene o se tasi e tulaga ese mai le au peresitene o le fitugafulu, ma ua faia mo i latou o e e lē malaga atu i le lalolagi atoa.

verses.en: And again, the duty of the President of the office of the High Priesthood is to preside over the whole church, and to be like unto Moses—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le tiute o le Peresitene o le tofi o le Perisitua Maualuga o le pulefaamalumalu i le ekalesia atoa, ma ia avea e pei o Mose—

verses.en: Behold, here is wisdom; yea, to be a seer, a revelator, a translator, and a prophet, having all the gifts of God which he bestows upon the head of the church.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le poto lenei; ioe, ia avea o se tagatavāai, o se talifaaaliga, o se faaliliu-upu, ma se perofeta, ua i ai meaalofa uma a le Atua e faaee mai e ia i luga o le ulu o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And it is according to the vision showing the order of the Seventy, that they should have seven presidents to preside over them, chosen out of the number of the seventy;
verses.sm: Ma ua tusa ai ma le faaaliga vaaia ua faaali mai ai le faatulagaga o le Toafitugafulu, e tatau ona i ai ia te i latou ni peresitene e toafitu e pulefaamalumalu i luga o i latou, e filifili mai i le aofai o le toafitugafulu;

verses.en: And the seventh president of these presidents is to preside over the six;
verses.sm: Ma o le lona fitu o peresitene o nei peresitene e toafitu e pulefaamalumalu i luga o le toaono;

verses.en: And these seven presidents are to choose other seventy besides the first seventy to whom they belong, and are to preside over them;
verses.sm: Ma o ia peresitene e toafitu e filifilia isi fitugafulu e ese mai fitugafulu muamua ua aofia ai i latou, ma ia pulefaamalumalu i o latou luga;

verses.en: And also other seventy, until seven times seventy, if the labor in the vineyard of necessity requires it.
verses.sm: Ma isi foi fitugafulu, seia faateleina faafitu le fitugafulu, pe afai e manaomia tatau ai i le galuega i le tovine.

verses.en: And these seventy are to be traveling ministers, unto the Gentiles first and also unto the Jews.
verses.sm: Ma o ia fitugafulu ia avea ma faifeau femalagaai, e muamua i Nuuese ma i tagata Iutaia foi.

verses.en: Whereas other officers of the church, who belong not unto the Twelve, neither to the Seventy, are not under the responsibility to travel among all nations, but are to travel as their circumstances shall allow, notwithstanding they may hold as high and responsible offices in the church.
verses.sm: A’o isi mautofi o le ekalesia, o e e lē i ai i le Toasefululua, po o le Toafitugafulu, ua lē i lalo o le tiutetauave e malaga atu i atunuu uma, ae e malaga pe a faatagaina ai e o latou tulaga, e ui atonu ua latou umia ni tofi e tutusa le maualuluga ma le taua i le ekalesia.

verses.en: Wherefore, now let every man learn his duty, and to act in the office in which he is appointed, in all diligence.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu nei i tagata taitoatasi e aoao lona tiute, ma galue i le tofi ua tofia i ai o ia, i le filiga atoa.

verses.en: He that is slothful shall not be counted worthy to stand, and he that learns not his duty and shows himself not approved shall not be counted worthy to stand. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e paie o le a lē faitauina e agavaa e tulai, ma o ia o lē e lē aoaoina lona tiute ma faaali mai ua lē faamaonia o ia lava, o le a lē faitauina e agavaa e tulai. E faapea lava. Amene.
